description: Rothco’s 2-Sided Staff T-Shirt is designed for event staff with a large, easily visible white “STAFF” print on the chest and back. A lightweight and breathable cotton/poly composition and classic fit make the security shirt ideal for all-day wear. A tagless label on the staff shirt makes for a hassle-free crew neck collar.
